findings.message: Direct distribution versions do not all match the release pins; use a reviewed platform-specific environment.
Metadata matching is not pip consistency, transitive lock validation, vulnerability auditing or a native import test.
Explicit file/defaults passed the existing complete Settings validators; no settings were applied or credentials transported.
Native checks require an explicitly reviewed private source-root .env, not a template/defaults.
Historical/mock configuration is not native MT5 provenance. No backend was replaced.
Actual private owner controls are unconfigured; a configured pair alone would still not authenticate an owner.
Configured state paths stay under this unlinked source root; none was created or opened for writing.
Native deployment requires actual Windows x64; this platform cannot establish MT5 readiness.
Logged-on non-Session-0 limited-user execution and actual NTFS/private-file ACLs require operator/native review.
Actual account kind, source, contracts, currencies, AI/news entitlements, Telegram/TLS and broker behavior were NOT contacted or validated.
Read-only free-space observation checked a 512 MiB diagnostic floor, not write permission or future capacity.
Database schema/state was not inspected. Use the explicit stopped/checkpointed SQLite snapshot flag or separately validate PostgreSQL; no ledger was created.
Offline checks are not actual-platform soak, restore, SDK/provider/owner/security tests, signed stage evidence or live approval.
All declared hashes/lengths and the bounded runnable/config file set match.
Content comparison only: an attacker can replace source AND manifest. Verify an independently trusted archive/digest.
